set.body: Benchmark only matched estimands at fixed shapes and seeds. Separate setup, compilation/materialization, and steady-state kernels; use JMH for ScalaFIM and repeated perf_counter plus allocation/RSS evidence for Python/Octave. Record distributions and hardware/runtime receipts. Do not compare startup or semantically different estimators; use work counters where wall time is not portable.
set.title: C6: benchmark matched MVPA scenarios and account for work
